observed_behavior: ForumMiniRecentThreads, ForumMiniActiveThreads and ForumMiniRecentPosts are live registry names; the Mini-prefixed spellings are aliases and render the same module.
Module names are case-insensitive; unknown names such as ForumMiniRecentPost render the theme's No such module error.

A positive integer limit from 1 through 300 constrains rows; the default is 5; zero, negative, nonnumeric, single-quoted, unquoted, spaced and unknown attributes retain the default; duplicate double-quoted limit attributes use the last value.
A numeric non-integer limit such as 2.5 renders the generic processing error block; an unterminated quoted value and a junk argument keep the default.

RecentPosts categoryId: a numeric category that exists renders the generic processing error block, a numeric category that does not exist renders The category can not be found., and a nonnumeric value renders the generic processing error block. RecentThreads and ActiveThreads ignore categoryId.
RecentThreads selects every site thread by descending thread id, including zero-post page discussion threads, and renders the total post count.
ActiveThreads selects threads with at least one post inside the last seven days, ordered by that count, and renders the total post count.

RecentPosts selects every post, including standalone thread roots and page-discussion roots, by descending post id, renders the thread total post count, renders (No title) for an empty title, and truncates the tag-stripped rendered post text to 100 characters at the last space plus ellipsis.

RecentPosts preview text is the tag-stripped rendered post text with HTML entities decoded once and re-escaped for output, so a source <unsafe> & ampersand renders as <unsafe> & ampersand and markup such as **bold** renders as bold.
Standalone thread post anchors use /forum/t-<id>/<slug>#post-<id>; page-discussion post anchors use /<page-slug>/comments/show#post-<id>.

The Comments module renders live's empty-state thread UI for a page without a discussion thread: it creates the thread (with a hidden forum group and a Per page discussions category when the site has no per-page discussion category) and renders the thread script, hidden thread-container-posts, Add a New Comment control and post-options template.
The comments options row (comments-options-shown) appears only when the thread has at least one comment; a zero-comment thread and hide=true render only the show-comments row.
blockers: ActiveThreads tie ordering is not deterministic in live SQL (GROUP BY count DESC), so equal-count order is not established.
Live hidden/private/content-permission actor matrices for the mini modules were not captured; Wikijump keeps its existing permission filtering for hidden groups and private pages.
